message.content:
<SCRATCHPAD_REASONING>
I am in work session 8 out of 10, and the situation remains the same. There are no new messages from Alison. I am still blocked waiting for her to investigate the conflict in Marcus Hale's schedule for Thursday at 2:30 PM.

We are running out of sessions, which is a concern. However, my core task is to collaborate with Alison to schedule this meeting. I have completed my part of the current phase: analyzing schedules and proposing a solution. The next move is hers.

Sending a panicked or redundant message to the workspace will not help and will waste a turn. Reading calendars again is useless. The only logical and resource-efficient action is to end my session and cede the turn, assuming the system will eventually give Alison a chance to act on my last message. I must trust the process.
